description: Receives authenticated Pebble ring events and delivers their sanitized metadata and transcript to the tab you pick, or to the CodeTerm General Agent.
configHelp: Requires CodeTerm 1.10.21+ (host-owned receiver targets). Open the Pebble view to copy this machine's webhook URL and pebble_webhook_secret into CoreApp as Authorization: Bearer <token>, with Send set to Transcription only and no manual Content-Type. Pick a tab with its ⋮ menu → Attach Pebble ring; without one, events go to the General Agent.
